description: Evaluates JavaScript in the selected page execution world when structured Actions cannot express the required operation.

pageId.description: Page ID where the JavaScript should run.

expression.description: JavaScript expression to evaluate in the page context.

world.description: Execution world: auto prefers the isolated world and may retry context-mismatch failures in the main world; isolated and main are strict.

purpose.description: Describe why custom JavaScript is necessary and why structured actions are insufficient

resultSchema.description: JSON-compatible value returned by the evaluated expression; inspect it before choosing the next structured Action.

observation.description: Facts directly observed by the Action or returned by its declared result schema.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

data.description: Validated business result returned by the Action.

message.description: Concise public explanation for the failure code.

observation.description: Directly observed failure fact; it must not infer an unobserved browser side effect.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

details.description: Only fields listed by the public error definition detailFields are returned; private execution diagnostics are omitted.
